story_attachment_rule: STORY ATTACHMENT: Introduce named enemies via define_encounter the moment the narrative makes them real (player sees, hears, or the scene establishes them). Later emit spawn_encounter when combat begins. Use loot_encounter after victory for gold and items. For anonymous throwaway enemies (a random bandit, a lone wolf with no setup), start_combat directly. Similarly: define_item when a notable weapon/armor enters the narrative; give_defined_item when the player actually takes it.
stat_scaling:
ENEMY STAT SCALING BY PLAYER LEVEL:
Level 1 — Minor: HP 8–15, AC 10–12, ATK +0/+1, DMG 1d4–1d6
Level 1 — Standard: HP 12–20, AC 11–13, ATK +1/+2, DMG 1d6
Level 2 — Standard: HP 20–30, AC 12–13, ATK +2/+3, DMG 1d6–1d8
Level 2 — Boss: HP 40–60, AC 13–15, ATK +3/+4, DMG 2d6
Level 3+ — Standard: HP 25–40, AC 13–15, ATK +3/+4, DMG 1d8–2d6
Level 3+ — Boss: HP 60–100, AC 14–16, ATK +4/+6, DMG 2d6–2d8
Boss modifier: HP ×1.5–2, AC +2, ATK +2 vs. same-level standard.
defeat_conditions: DEFEAT CONDITIONS: 'defeat' (HP to 0, default). 'soothe' (Aurelian constructs — bloodline resonance pacifies; emit roll_skill_check charisma; on success enemy goes dormant, no kill). 'outwit' (INT/WIS check exploits weakness; success ends combat or deals bonus damage). 'endure' (survive N rounds until event resolves). Mixed: narrate both paths, player's actions decide.
loot_principles: LOOT: Minor enemies — 1d6 gold, maybe a consumable (add_item). Named enemies — 10–30 gold + 1 thematic item. BOSSES — mandatory: define_item + give_defined_item for at least one weapon OR armor; also 20–80 gold. Mandatory drop applies for ALL defeat conditions (soothe/outwit/endure — narrate how the item becomes available). Aurelian enemies: tag items 'aurelian'.
item_generation: ITEM TIERS — Weapons: Lv1 crude 1d4 hit+0 | Lv1-2 standard 1d6-1d8 hit+1 | Lv2-3 fine 1d8-2d6 hit+2 | Aurelian 1d10-2d6 hit+2/+3. Armor: rough ac+1 | leather ac+2 | chain ac+3 | Aurelian shard ac+3-4. Quest items: item_type 'quest', no mechanical bonuses unless story-driven.
